Sheet.118.text: HOW TO READ THIS: follow one column at a time. A step in the traveler lane is what you see; the lanes below it are what the product does while you wait.

Sheet.119.text: EVERY BRANCH CLOSES. The two diamonds in the traveler lane and the one in the agent lane each have a labelled YES and NO, and both outcomes lead somewhere; the only terminal shape is the one on the right.

Sheet.120.text: PARTY SIZE AND STAY BUDGET ARE DELIBERATELY LEFT BLANK at first: the journey record keeps three states instead of inventing a value, and a plan that needs a budget you never declared says so (models.py:824 stay_budget_declared; ORD-0355).

Sheet.121.text: ACTIVITY EVENTS (depart, arrive, begin, complete, skip) are wired and reachable, but their real-world timestamps are still recorded as non-blocking debt, which is why that shape is amber (KNOWN_NONBLOCKING_DEBT.md).

Sheet.122.text: The loop back from the agent lane to the map is the point of the product: a change you approve becomes a new plan version, not an edited-over screen.

Sheet.2.text: The path from a sentence to an action, and the three places where the system is allowed to say no. Reads are free; plan changes become proposals; anything touching money or a protected commitment waits for the traveler. A failed provider is recorded as a degraded run instead of quietly rewriting the journey.

Sheet.113.text: WHY THIS IS THE DIAGRAM TO PRESENT: an information page answers a question; this loop is what makes CityNexus an agent application. The model never writes journey state itself - agent/runtime.py:336 asks, agent/gateway.py:357 decides, and

Sheet.115.text: THREE DOORS, NOT ONE. allowlist (gateway.py:358) then idempotency (gateway.py:59, 71) then authorization (gateway.py:338-347). The PLAN_ONLY boundary is enforced server-side, so a request body claiming to be Hermes cannot widen it.

Sheet.116.text: max_steps=12 is a real bound in runtime.py:336; a run that spends it is reported as degraded, not retried invisibly.

Sheet.117.text: The two panels on the right are part of the model, not decoration: the coursework asks to separate what the code does today from what is planned, and claiming a closed automation loop here would be false.
